name: Torr2Jelly
description: TorrServer torrent streaming & Prowlarr/Torznab integration for Jellyfin
overview: Stream torrents instantly on Jellyfin without waiting for downloads. Features direct TorrServer streaming, Prowlarr search, and automated .strm library generation.

versions.changelog: Optimized cache and seeding settings: reduced PreloadCache default to 3% (~3 GB for 100 GB cache) to prevent server lags/freezes on 100 GB releases, increased post-playback seeding duration (TorrentDisconnectTimeout) to 24 hours (86400s), ensured RemoveCacheOnDrop is false, and added UI controls and presets in Settings tab.
